identity_cost.detail: An email or GitHub or Google account creates the account, but no Droplet or other resource can be created before a valid payment method is added. Credit and debit cards are accepted and virtual, electron and prepaid cards are refused. Cards issued in or with billing addresses from OFAC-sanctioned countries are prohibited. No phone number is asked for.
